conversion_notes: document.md is a full transcription of the paper: every section, paragraph, proposition, theorem and proof, the appendix of proofs (source pages 25-36) included, plus all 13 footnotes and the reference list. The authors' first person and the printed numbering are preserved.
The mathematics was re-keyed as LaTeX and checked against 150 dpi renders of the source pages. The tridiagonal matrices are written out as matrices, as printed.
The rendered source pages of the appendix are kept under assets/proof-pages/ as a check on the transcription, not as a substitute for it.
The backtest section is the paper's own: one day of France Telecom data, with the production algorithm explicitly not disclosed.
equations.md is a flat index of the same equations, for retrieval.
conversion_check: Every pure-prose ten-word window of the source PDF text layer was verified to occur in document.md; the only non-matches are artifacts of running headers, line-break hyphenation, figure axis labels and mathematical notation.
